name: Email Automation - Send Engine

parameters.query: SELECT s.id AS sequence_id, s.tenant_id, s.agent_id, s.lead_id, s.sequence_type, s.demo_url, s.screenshot_url, s.step, l.business_name, l.email FROM lead_email_sequences s JOIN gmaps_leads l ON l.id = s.lead_id WHERE s.status = 'active' AND l.email IS NOT NULL AND l.email <> '' AND (s.step = 0 OR (s.step BETWEEN 1 AND 4 AND s.last_sent_at <= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours')) ORDER BY s.step ASC, s.last_sent_at ASC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 50;
INSERT INTO lead_email_sends (sequence_id, step, email_type, message_id, subject, html) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6) RETURNING id;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$("Build Email Content").item.json.sequence_id, $("Build Email Content").item.json.next_step, $("Build Email Content").item.json.email_type, $json.messageId ?? "", $("Build Email Content").item.json.subject, $("Build Email Content").item.json.html] }}

parameters.query: UPDATE lead_email_sequences SET step = $1, status = $2, last_sent_at = NOW() WHERE id = $3;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$("Build Email Content").item.json.next_step, $("Build Email Content").item.json.new_status, $("Build Email Content").item.json.sequence_id] }}

parameters.query: UPDATE lead_email_sequences SET status = 'failed' WHERE id = $1;

parameters.content:
## Email Automation - Send Engine (v1)

Handles the SENDING side only: finds active sequences due for their next email (initial at step 0, follow-ups every 24h up to step 4), sends via Brevo, logs to lead_email_sends, and advances step/status.

Not included yet (needs an Anthropic billing fix first): automatic enrollment of new leads into a sequence, which requires generating the actual website mockup or chatbot demo per lead. Until that ships, leads must be enrolled into lead_email_sequences some other way (e.g. a manual insert) for this engine to pick them up.

Reply capture is already handled by POST /webhooks/inbound-reply in the API. No n8n work needed there.

Requires a Brevo credential named "Brevo" (sendInBlueApi) to be attached to the Send Outreach Email node.

notes: Status: built and verified (real 'Fetch Due Sequences' execution against the live DB returned 0 rows, as expected since no leads are enrolled yet), but NOT YET PUBLISHED - blocked on a Brevo credential (type sendInBlueApi, named 'Brevo') that has not been created in n8n yet. Once added and attached to the 'Send Outreach Email' node, publish the workflow to activate the hourly schedule. Scope: send-engine only (finds due sequences, sends via Brevo, logs to lead_email_sends, advances step/status, marks status='failed' on a Brevo send error). Auto-enrollment (deciding website_demo vs chatbot_demo per new lead and generating the referenced AI demo) is out of scope for this workflow - it depends on the same blocked Anthropic billing issue as the Website Preview/Chatbot Demo workflows, since a demo must exist before a lead can be meaningfully enrolled. Until enrollment is built, rows must be inserted into lead_email_sequences some other way for this engine to have anything to send. Reply capture (marking a sequence 'replied') is already fully handled server-side by POST /webhooks/inbound-reply - no n8n component needed for that.
